rules.message: agent-policy: this NixOS system is declarative. Declare the package in ~/nix-config and rebuild, or use an ephemeral 'nix shell nixpkgs#<pkg> --command ...' for one-off needs.
agent-policy: polling CI in a sleep loop wastes tokens and reinvents the wheel. Use: gh run watch <run-id> --exit-status

agent-policy: a traversal rooted at / or the nix store enumerates an enormous tree. Resolve instead: readlink -f "$(command -v <bin>)" for a binary's store path; nix eval nixpkgs#<pkg>.outPath for a package; nix-locate <file> for file-to-package. Otherwise pick a reasoned root (~/Documents/personal/repositories, ~/nix-config) and search there.
agent-policy: recursive grep from / or the nix store reads an enormous tree. Resolve the location first (readlink -f, nix eval, nix-locate), then search a reasoned root.

agent-policy: /mnt/* paths are slow network/Windows mounts where every directory read is a round trip. Search from a deep, specific root with -maxdepth 3 or less (e.g. find /mnt/t/<AREA>/<CLIENT> -maxdepth 2 -iname '*<term>*'), or ls the target directory first to orient.

agent-policy: this cd targets a slow network/Windows mount and the script then walks the filesystem. Search from a deep, specific root with -maxdepth 3 or less, or ls the target directory first to orient.

agent-policy: inside a git repository, query the index first: git ls-files '*<name>*', or fd/rg which honor .gitignore. Raw find must bound its walk: -not -path '*/.venv/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*', a -prune, or a -maxdepth.
